(C) Land left out of cultivation for a time that it may recover its strength
(D) Land uncultivated for five years and more

1. Polaj: Land annually cultivated for each crop in succession and never allowed to lie fallow -> (III).

4. Banjar: Land uncultivated for five years and more -> (II).
Thus, (A) - (III), (B) - (IV), (C) - (I), (D) - (II).
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.
